title: The Deadlands
description: A datapack adding a new late game dimension to Vanilla minecraft. Requires the Deadlands Resources resource pack. (1.20.4, 1.20.5 coming soon)
body:
The Deadlands data pack requires the Deadlands Resources resource pack: [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/deadlands-resources](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/deadlands-resources) If you are the owner of a server, you can run this resource pack as a server resource pack!

This project is in early access. to submit bug reports, feedback, or get news on future versions, join the Discord: [[https://discord.gg/8AdT2E8B](https://discord.gg/8AdT2E8B)](https://discord.gg/n7SKDZCJUv)

The Deadlands is a datapack adding a new and fully custom fourth dimension to vanilla minecraft. The project is in early access and currently contains 11 biomes, 27 advancements, 2 custom armor sets, dozens of new loot items, new foods, monsters, dungeons and more! 

This datapack is Realms and multiplayer friendly and only requires the associated resource pack.

Currently only works in version 1.20.4 but a 1.20.6 version is in development!
